title: Robust Multithreaded Web Crawler
tagline: WPF desktop crawler with MSSQL storage and multithreading
intro: University project: a multithreaded web crawler with a responsive WPF UI and MSSQL-backed persistence.
summary: C# + WPF application that recursively crawls within domain boundaries, extracts anchor links, and stores results in MSSQL. Multithreading keeps the UI responsive during deep crawls.
features: Domain filtering to exclude external links

sections.title: Description
sections.body: A robust WPF-based crawler that traverses websites, extracts anchor links, and stores them in MSSQL while maintaining UI responsiveness via multithreading.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Demonstrate scalable crawling, concurrency, and structured persistence with solid OOP design.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Engineered the crawler core, integrated MSSQL, built the WPF UI, implemented thread management, and added domain filters.

sections.title: Features / Implementation
sections.body: Threaded crawl workers; HTML parsing for anchors; domain allowlist; MSSQL schema for results; progress and control via WPF.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Delivered a reusable crawling framework showcasing advanced OOP and concurrency in a desktop setting.
